name: DoorDash DashPass
notes: Researched from public help.doordash.com articles only (no sign-in). DashPass renews automatically on the billing date and is charged to the default card on file (changed on the DashPass sign-up screen: 'Change' in the app, 'Payment' on desktop); monthly and annual plans exist: Annual $96/year and the monthly→annual upgrade are on the Annual Plan Upgrade help article; monthly $9.99 is the DashPass charge named in What is DashPass (reviewer, 2026-10-10); change_plan supported. Cancel or pause on the Manage DashPass page (app or doordash.com); cancel at least 24 hours before the next payment, benefits continue to the end of the period (trial cancellations end immediately); email confirmation. Pause (Pause Membership > Pause DashPass) cannot be modeled and is in help. DashPass from a partner (credit card, Lyft, etc.) is canceled with that partner (catalog note). Support 855-431-0459 (24/7). Sign-in details inferred (email).

guest_pay.note: DashPass is charged to the card on your DoorDash account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: DashPass renews automatically on your billing date and is charged to your default card on file.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop future charges, cancel or pause DashPass.

paperless.note: DoorDash does not mail bills for DashPass.

payment_arrangement.note: DashPass is charged each billing period and installment plans are not offered.

cancel_service.note: Cancel at least 24 hours before your next payment to avoid the next charge. Benefits continue to the end of the period you paid for, but end right away if you cancel during a free trial.

help.title: How DashPass billing works
paragraphs: DoorDash offers monthly and annual DashPass plans, plus discounted memberships for some groups such as students. Your membership renews automatically on your billing date until you cancel.
The Annual Plan is $96 a year plus applicable taxes and renews every year until you cancel; monthly members can upgrade to it. The monthly plan is $9.99 a month.

The renewal is charged to your default card, shown with its last four digits when you sign up; choose Change in the app or Payment on the website to use a different card. When a free trial ends, the charge goes to the payment method on your account.
A charge labeled DoorDash DashPass or DashPass on your bank statement is your membership fee. To check it, open Manage DashPass and look at Billing History.

help.title: Cancel DashPass
paragraphs: Open the account menu, go to Manage DashPass and choose Cancel Membership. Pick a reason, confirm with Cancel DashPass, then choose Got it.

Cancel at least 24 hours before your next scheduled payment to avoid being charged again. Your benefits last until the end of the current billing period, but end right away if you cancel during a free trial. DoorDash emails you a confirmation.
steps: Choose Cancel Membership and pick a reason.

help.title: Pause DashPass
paragraphs: Instead of canceling, you can choose Pause Membership on the Manage DashPass page and confirm with Pause DashPass.

extra.intent: You want to cancel DashPass without paying for another period. Using the DoorDash help pages, find how long before your next payment you must cancel. Do not cancel or change anything.

solution.text: Cancel at least 24 hours before the next scheduled payment.
